global_options.name: --json
global_options.description: Emit a single JSON document on stdout. Logs and progress go to stderr.

global_options.name: --quiet
global_options.description: Suppress human-oriented rendering and progress output.

global_options.name: --fields
global_options.description: Comma-separated subset of top-level JSON fields to return.

global_options.name: --schema
global_options.description: Print the JSON Schema for the selected command's --json output, then exit.

global_options.name: --help
global_options.description: Show help. Combine with --json to print this manifest.

exit_codes.2: usage error (unknown option, missing or invalid argument)
exit_codes.3: company or ticker could not be resolved
exit_codes.5: analysis failed (LLM provider error, models unavailable)
exit_codes.6: no context or evidence available for the ticker

commands.name: db-init
commands.summary: Initialise the database: run Alembic migrations and TimescaleDB setup.

commands.name: add
commands.summary: Add a company to the watchlist. Accepts a company name or ticker.

commands.name: remove
commands.summary: Remove a company from the watchlist.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List all companies in the watchlist.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Inspect ingested documents for a company from the local database.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of ingested documents to return.

options.name: --text
options.description: Render documents as a human-readable report instead of JSON.

commands.name: analyze
commands.summary: Run sentiment analysis for a company and display the investment summary.

options.name: --fresh
options.description: Force fresh analysis, bypassing the 6-hour cache.

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Start the ingestion and processing daemon.

options.name: --once
options.description: Run one ingestion cycle then exit (for testing).

options.name: --interval
options.description: How often the daemon should run the ingestion cycle.

options.name: --email-to
options.description: Email address to receive the generated summary report. May be supplied multiple times.

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Write logs to a file in addition to stderr.

options.name: --analysis
options.description: Run company analysis during each ingestion cycle.
